hello_fresh_vs_everyplate.meta_description: Side-by-side HelloFresh and EveryPlate terms from official pages only: promos, cutoffs, cancel and support paths, with capture dates and sources.

HelloFresh.display: Get Free Breakfast for Life + 10 Free Meals on Us! Conditions on page: For Life, on first box, One per box with active subscription.

EveryPlate.display: Get $2.99/Meal on Your First Box + Free Lunch for a Month on Us! (also lists 10% off terms for boxes 2–5 on the same page).

HelloFresh.display: Vouchers are only for first-time users of HelloFresh, unless the Voucher states otherwise.

EveryPlate.display: Vouchers are only for first-time users of EveryPlate, unless the Voucher states otherwise.

HelloFresh.display: Pause/cancel by 11:59 pm PST 5 days prior to your next scheduled delivery (FAQ). Account changes must be before the day and time listed on My Menu (Terms §10.3).

EveryPlate.display: All changes (skip, meals, plan, cancel) must be made 5 days before delivery by 11:59 PM ET. Cancel before weekly cutoff (5 days before delivery) to avoid charge for a prepared box.

HelloFresh.display: See our HelloFresh cancellation guide (Account Settings / FAQ flow; sources linked there).

EveryPlate.display: See our EveryPlate cancellation guide (Account Settings → Manage; sources linked there).

personas.heading: You need a published per-meal dollar headline for the first box
personas.body: On 2026-09-17, EveryPlate’s official coupon page published $2.99/meal on the first box; HelloFresh’s official coupon page published meal-count benefits without a per-meal dollar price on the same capture run.

personas.heading: Your schedule depends on cutoff timezone wording
personas.body: HelloFresh’s FAQ uses 11:59 pm PST five days before delivery; EveryPlate’s FAQ uses 11:59 PM ET five days before delivery. Use the weekly cutoff row above and each brand’s linked official page for your delivery week.

personas.heading: You are comparing cancel or support steps before you subscribe
personas.body: Use the cancel-path and customer-service rows to open this site’s guides for each brand; those pages quote only linked HelloFresh or EveryPlate official help, FAQ, or terms sources.

factor_vs_cookunity.meta_description: Factor vs CookUnity from official pages only: first-box promos, cutoffs, voucher rules, cancel and support links, with capture dates.

Factor.display: Get 50% Off + Free Breakfast for 1 Year (homepage banner). Separate line: 20% off applies to boxes 2–5.

CookUnity.display: Get 50% off your first week of chef-made, ready-to-eat meals (discount landing page).

Factor.display: Vouchers are only for first-time users of Factor, unless the Voucher states otherwise.

CookUnity.display: Vouchers are only for first-time users of CookUnity, unless the Voucher states otherwise. Referral credits: valid for new customers only; limited to one per household address.

Factor.display: Change menu, skip, or cancel before 11:59 p.m. PST 5 days prior to your next scheduled delivery.

CookUnity.display: Strict cutoff for modifications: four to six days before your delivery day at noon (Terms). Canceling stops future weeks but not orders already processed/billed (Help Center).

Factor.display: See our Factor cancellation guide (Account Settings → End Meal Subscription; sources linked there).

CookUnity.display: See our CookUnity cancellation guide (Settings → Cancel Subscription on web/app; sources linked there).

Factor.display: See our Factor customer service guide (phone/chat from factor75.com/contact).

personas.heading: You want ready-to-eat meals with a published first-box percent-off banner
personas.body: Both brands published 50%-style first-order messaging on 2026-09-17 (Factor homepage; CookUnity discount LP). Neither published a full standard-box dollar price on those same official pages—see the price row.

personas.heading: Cutoff rules are your deciding paperwork
personas.body: Factor’s FAQ states 11:59 p.m. PST five days before delivery. CookUnity’s Terms state a four-to-six-day window before delivery day at noon. Neither row replaces checking My Menu / account timing for your zip.

personas.heading: You need chef-marketplace referral rules in writing
personas.body: CookUnity’s Terms publish first-time voucher language plus referral new-customer-only and one-per-household limits. Factor’s Terms publish first-time voucher language without those referral sentences on the same Section 9 capture.
